title: Drift Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: A Chart.js line chart of accumulated drift versus days for a Pico crystal (30 ppm), DS1307 (20 ppm), DS3231 (2 ppm), and a custom ppm, with days until one minute off.

learningObjectives: Calculate accumulated drift from ppm and elapsed time
Compare how long different clock sources stay within one minute
prerequisites: Parts per million and the drift formula (Chapter 13)

keyQuestions: How many days until each source is one minute off?
Why are the drift lines straight?
commonMisconceptions: A clock that is accurate today stays accurate forever
A small ppm difference does not matter over a year
assessmentOpportunities: Compute the one-year drift of a 20 ppm crystal
Estimate ppm from a measured error after 100 days
